description: This file defines a React component called DataGrid used for rendering a data table with features like pagination, search, and dynamic column resizing in the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: DataGrid
classes.description: A React component for displaying a customizable, paginated data grid with search and dynamic column resizing.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DataGrid component with default and provided props, setting up initial state and refs.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up resize event listener and initializes column sizing.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates visible columns if the columns prop changes.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Adjusts visible columns based on container width and fixed columns.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders table rows, loading indicator, or empty state.

methods.name: renderSearch
methods.description: Renders the search component if onSearch is provided.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Triggers loading of the next page if not currently loading.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Triggers loading of the previous page if not currently loading.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles search term input and calls onSearch prop.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders pagination controls with current item count and navigation buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method assembling the data grid layout.
